title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - PhysicalResource
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/PhysicalResource. A Physical resource is, but not limited to, a datacenter, a bare-metal service, a warehouse, a plant. Those are entities that have a weight and position in physical space. Subclass of Resource per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Resource model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PhysicalResource'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

maintainedBy.description: Relationship. Participants maintaining the resource in operational condition and thus having physical access to it. Links to one or more LegalPerson entities.

aggregationOfResources.description: Relationship. Resources related to the resource that can exist independently of it. Links to one or more Resource entities.

ownedBy.description: Relationship. Participant(s) owning the resource. Links to one or more LegalPerson entities.

manufacturedBy.description: Relationship. Participant(s) manufacturing the resource. Links to one or more LegalPerson entities.

location.description: Relationship. Physical location(s) of the resource. Links to one or more Address entities.

energyUsageEfficiency.description: Relationship. Information about energy usage efficiency including certifications and metrics. Links to an EnergyUsageEfficiency entity.

waterUsageEffectiveness.description: Relationship. Information regarding water usage effectiveness including certifications. Links to a WaterUsageEffectiveness entity.

energyMix.description: Relationship. Information on the composition of the energy mix used by the resource, including percentages of renewable and carbon-free energy. Links to one or more EnergyMix entities.
